snippet.title: Aura: Echoes of Pain | Latin American Games Showcase TGA 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
AURA: Echoes of Pain is a 2.5D puzzle-platformer about memory, trauma, and redemption. Play as Aura, a witch wandering through a desolate world while reliving her childhood in vibrant, playable memories. Past and present intertwine through puzzles and emotions in a poetic journey of self-discovery.
